mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 30 days (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightening indicated by unemployment rate falling below 5.0% triggers increased corporate hiring and wage growth, boosting near-term equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE falls below 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal occurs in more than 40% of the sample without positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust aggregate demand, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint growth in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances (positive return rate < 50%) or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening supply capacity, leading to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as central banks tighten policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO declines in late-cycle expansion (t-test p > 0.05) or the negative return rate is below 55% in triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in residential construction (HOUST) exceeding 1800 thousand units triggers increased housing sector activity, boosting consumer confidence and generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST exceeds 1800.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the positive return rate is below 60% in triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing output, leading to lower corporate profits and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a central bank's attempt to combat stagflation, causing equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances (negative return rate < 50%) or Rank IC > 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime, a sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% signals economic distress, triggering immediate negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises above 6.0% in a tight labor market (t-test p > 0.05) or the negative return rate is below 60% in triggered instances.
